results.title: Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub
results.content:
Participating organizations retain control over what they release and how it is shared. Their commitments are set out in non-binding, non-exclusive memoranda of understanding with Hugging Face.

Hugging Face reports that researchers shared more than three times as many new science datasets on its platform in the first nine months of 2026 as in the same period of 2025. It also reports that fully documented datasets account for 90% of dataset downloads on the Hub. [...] #### A climate challenge spanning 210 cities

Carnegie Mellon University is hosting the first ProtoStar challenge, Climate Risk Intelligence, from November 2 to 13, 2026.

Teams will use historical weather records from 210 US cities to predict annual conditions for 2019–2025. Forecast inputs must use records dated no later than December 31, 2018, preventing teams from feeding the actual outcomes into their predictions. [...] Previous

message.content:
## Recent developments
- **Nvidia Acquisition and DOJ Scrutiny:** The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) initiated inquiries into Nvidia's proposed $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Regulators are examining how the deal—which gives a major hardware manufacturer control over a primary open-weight model distribution hub—will affect AI market competition.
- **Leadership and Ecosystem Stance:** Following the deal announcements, CEO Clem Delangue and co-founders have doubled down on commitments to keep fighting for open-source and open-weight AI. Meanwhile, the platform reported sharp growth in scientific data sharing, with science datasets tripling in the first nine months of 2026.
- **Launch of "ProtoStar":** Hugging Face partnered with universities via the Open Forum for AI (OFAI) to launch ProtoStar, an open science initiative. Carnegie Mellon University hosted the inaugural Climate Risk Intelligence challenge in early November 2026 to apply public research and historical weather data to predictive models.

## Talking points
- **Regulatory Landscape:** Discuss how the DOJ antitrust inquiry might affect the timeline, structure, or closing conditions of the Nvidia acquisition.
- **Open-Source Integrity:** Address developer and community concerns regarding independence, neutrality, and continued support for non-Nvidia hardware ecosystems on the Hub post-acquisition.
- **Strategic Initiatives:** Highlight the traction of the ProtoStar initiative and how Hugging Face is scaling institutional partnerships (such as with CMU) to drive open-science data sharing.

## Open questions
- How will the DOJ inquiry impact the expected closing timeline of the $12.93 billion acquisition by Nvidia?
- What specific governance or structural safeguards will Hugging Face put in place to ensure model distribution neutrality for competitors like AMD and Google?
- How is the engineering team managing the massive surge in scientific dataset uploads and community traffic while maintaining platform performance?

## Sources
- [Nvidia + Hugging Face: 5 DOJ Probe Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/nvidia-hugging-face-doj-inquiry-12-93b-meta-becerra-pac-2026)
- [Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were 'our savior'](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/hugging-face-cofounder-open-weight-ai-models-were-our-savior-220000916.html)
- [Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
- [Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
- [CMU to Host Challenge to Put Scientific Data to Work With AI - News - Carnegie Mellon University](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-to-host-challenge-to-put-scientific-data-to-work-with-ai)
